# Orcan

> Work-context orchestrator for coding agents (Cursor CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in Docker — workspaces, path parity, context pack. Does not choose or route models.

Orcan describes which repositories belong together, mounts them with the same absolute paths on host and in the container, seeds agent-facing starter files, and runs agents inside Docker. Prefer the pages below over crawling the whole site. In a live Orcan workspace, also read the context pack (`AGENTS.md`, `.manifest.json`) — that is stronger than this public index.

## Start here

- [Why Orcan?](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/why-orcan/): Problem, when to use / not use, non-goals
- [Core Ideas](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/ideas/core-ideas/): Project, Workspace, Context
- [Mental Model](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/ideas/mental-model/): How the pieces relate (incl. path parity)
- [Quick Start](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/getting-started/quickstart/): First successful run
- [Change map](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/change-map/): What to edit → where in the repo → which doc

## Concepts and architecture

- [Workspaces](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/concepts/workspaces/): Named project sets and sessions
- [Path parity](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/concepts/path-parity/): Same absolute paths host ↔ container
- [Architecture](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/architecture/): Layers and why they look this way
- [Context Assertions](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/ideas/context-assertions/): Compiled, human-approved context
- [Runtime reconcile](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/ideas/runtime-reconcile/): How sync affects a running container
- [Agent inbox](https://akyther.github.io/orcan/latest/ideas/agent-inbox/): Handoff notes for agents
